summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: @onereach/salesforce-miaw-client@0.0.4 declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-style script which, when `bun` is not already installed, downloads the Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/... into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled ~720KB sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using string-array-rotation obfuscation (a rotator function shuffles a large literal table; identifiers are hex-mangled), and its filename is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose. The advertised functionality — a Salesforce MIAW SSE client — is delivered by `dist/index.umd.js` and does not require an alternate JavaScript runtime or a 720KB opaque sibling script. The alternate-runtime execution path evades Node-focused tooling and causes attacker-controlled code to run on the installer's machine as a side effect of `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
